title: Feadship Delivers 71.76m Superyacht Stella M
description: Feadship delivers the 71.76m superyacht Stella M, showcasing innovative design, advanced propulsion, and collaborative excellence for a seamless Mediterranean voyage.
html:
Feadship successfully delivered the 71.76-meter superyacht Stella M to her owner. Constructed at the renowned Dutch shipyard, this vessel was meticulously designed by Studio De Voogt, featuring five decks tailored for multi-generational enjoyment. The collaboration with Burgess, who represented the owner throughout the construction process, and technical guidance from Hugo-Morgan Harris, ensured that the project met the highest standards.

Maarten Janssen, Feadship’s Sales Director, highlighted the shared commitment to excellence that shaped Stella M. The yacht’s design and construction reflect a dedication to creating a vessel that stands out for its engineering and functionality. The successful delivery marks another milestone for Feadship, reinforcing its reputation for producing exceptional yachts.

Innovative Diesel-Electric Propulsion System

Stella M is equipped with a cutting-edge diesel-electric propulsion system, marking a significant advancement in yacht engineering. This system is designed to minimize noise and vibration, contributing to a more serene cruising experience. During sea trials, the propulsion system demonstrated its effectiveness, confirming the vessel’s capability for quieter and cleaner navigation.

Richard Lambert, Senior Partner at Burgess, emphasized the importance of collaboration in achieving the owner’s forward-thinking vision. The integration of advanced propulsion technology aligns with the vessel’s overall design ethos, ensuring that Stella M not only meets but exceeds contemporary standards for performance and environmental consideration.

Stella M Begins Mediterranean Voyage

Following her delivery, Stella M is set to embark on her inaugural Mediterranean season. This journey will offer the opportunity to experience the yacht’s capabilities in diverse maritime environments. The vessel’s design and engineering are expected to perform seamlessly, providing a testament to the meticulous planning and execution involved in her construction.

As Stella M sets sail, she represents a significant achievement for all parties involved. The yacht’s delivery and upcoming voyage underscore the successful collaboration between Feadship, Burgess, and the technical team, all of whom contributed to bringing this vision to life. Stella M is poised to make a notable impact on the waters of the Mediterranean.

The delivery of Stella M marks a noteworthy achievement in yacht construction and design. The vessel’s innovative features and collaborative creation process reflect a commitment to excellence and forward-thinking solutions. As Stella M begins her Mediterranean journey, she stands as a testament to the possibilities of modern yacht engineering.
